operations.fixedDirectoryAndLeafReadOnlyOpen: 18 exact directories+4 regular leaves, O_RDONLY|NOFOLLOW|NONBLOCK; directories also O_DIRECTORY. No file read/pread/hash.
operations.alias: Only exact original alias named lstat twice, up to two readlink calls, two fixed-path follow-stat calls, one access probe. Kernel may resolve its chain; no application traversal/open/admission of returned target paths.
operations.privateStdio: Only fixed leaf metadata/fstat and W_OK observation; zero contents, no write/open-write.
operations.permissions: Current observer's UID/group mode bits and effective-ID os.access if supported; absence of support is reported and never replaced with guessed launchd/TCC evidence.
operations.finalBinding: Full9 at named/FD open and final checks; exact five-field original T5 anchor object identities, no fresh diskutil/UUID claim.

closure: Pre-register each empty row before open; installed handlers record pending and never throw across returned-FD assignment. Every returned FD has one close attempt. Restore original handlers, check pending and final deadline, then flush and reject late/signal. Only actual exit0 plus complete post-closure output qualifies observation.
failureProjection: Only fixed stage and ordinal, fixed Refused code, exception type, bounded errno. No dynamic filename/message/link text or unknown link hash.
explicitLimits: Synchronous filesystem syscalls are not hard-preemptible; late return fails.
Metadata does not prove current file contents or loaded code bytes.
Observed access is not launchd or TCC permission proof.
Full9 drift or unexpected errors stop this operation; no fallback path, retries, dir scan, chmod, TCC change, process start or SDK.
